title: Grandma's Hamburger Hot Dish
description: This hamburger casserole made with cream of mushroom soup and egg noodle pasta is a warm and comforting meal, just like Grandma used to make.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter for greasing, or as needed
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a casserole dish with butter. Arrange uncooked noodles in the prepared dish.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef, onion, and celery in the hot skillet until beef is browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes; drain and discard grease.
Stir condensed soups, mushrooms, and milk into beef mixture until evenly combined; pour over noodles in the dish. Cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove aluminum foil and sprinkle cashews on top; continue baking until bubbling, about 30 minutes more.
